posts.post_caption:
Developing LLM applications can be complex, but Opik simplifies the process. With 20 thousand stars on GitHub and an Apache-2.0 open-source license, this Python-based platform is designed to streamline your AI development.

Opik helps you:
* Debug, evaluate, and monitor LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows.
* Get comprehensive tracing of LLM calls, conversation logging, and agent activity.
* Utilize advanced evaluation tools and automatic prompt optimization.
* Build, test, and optimize generative AI applications that run better, from prototype to production.

Check it out:
https://github.com/comet-ml/opik
